description: South Korea sole proprietor to corporation conversion (개인사업자 법인전환): minimum capital (net asset value at market), capital gains tax deferred by 조특법 제32조 이월과세 on business real estate, and the 50% acquisition tax relief (지특법 제57조의2 ④, through 2027-12-31, not for real estate rental) net of the 20% rural special tax. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Houses are excluded from the deferral.

acquisitionBase.description: Acquisition tax base if different from market value, KRW; 0 uses market value

business.description: Business type; consumption services (lodging, bars) get no deferral or relief

otherAssets.description: Other business assets at market value, KRW

realEstateCost.description: Acquisition cost plus necessary expenses of that real estate, KRW

realEstateMarket.description: Market value of business real estate (not houses), KRW
